source_en: Officer. Why are you standing at my fire? The trash will not carry itself.
What are you doing out here?
Thinking. Something you could try too, once that trash is in the bin where it belongs.
The only trouble here is an officer who wandered off from his chores. Go and fix that.
Then check on the trash. The yard is filthy, and you are out here warming your hands. Go. Back to work.
You again, Officer? My fire is not part of your rounds. The booth is waiting.
Calm enough. I would be calmer if you were at your window, doing your job.
Only where your booth is. And watch the yard, something not human came through last night.
Good advice, Officer. Take it yourself, and take it back to the booth.
